name: Drop Nineteens
lede: Drop Nineteens started at Boston University in 1990, made two albums and were done by 1995. Their song "Delaware" plays over the end of Pete & Pete, and in 2023 the band came back with Hard Light.

facts.h: They started out as In April Rain
facts.p: Greg Ackell led the band at Boston University in 1990 with Chris Roof, Steve Zimmerman and Motohiro Yasue, and Paula Kelley joined as co-vocalist. The Mayfield demo got the British music press interested.

src.title: Five ex-Drop Nineteens tell their story (Boston Hassle)

facts.h: "Delaware" plays out the last Pete & Pete
facts.p: KEXP's Dusty Henry notes the song's guitar line swirling under the closing moments of the series finale, "Saturday."

src.title: "Get a Life, Jerk Weed!" or: How I Became a Music Fan Through The Adventures of Pete & Pete (KEXP)

facts.p: That got Ackell writing again. Hard Light, made with Kelley, Zimmerman, Yasue and drummer Pete Koeplin, came out on Wharf Cat on November 3, 2023.
